top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver who the director stated received orientation during hire did not have documentation of the verified orientation.    This was corrected during inspection with the director and caregiver signing completion of orientation.

top_violation_types.title: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine (26 TAC §746.623(2)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's immunization record did not have the signature (including a rubber stamp or electronic signature) of the health-care professional who administered the vaccine.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Accessible to Children (26 TAC §746.2705(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age children do not have individual cubbies or space for their personal belongings.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have a copy of their educational documents on file for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.
